ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) surface with localized high-intensity (white) pixel clusters; estimated high-to-low intensity ratio is less than 0.05.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Uniform low-intensity base across both lobes. High-intensity circular clusters concentrated at distal tips. Discrete high-intensity pixel points (blobs) distributed sparsely across the interior ventral surface.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with an internal pixel angle of approximately 42 degrees; notch depth occupies approximately 18% of the visible vertical fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency micro-serrations along the entire boundary. Significant pixel-amplitude variations (valleys) observed on the medial section of the right lobe trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve originating from the median notch, transitioning to a linear-tapered trajectory toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely packed clusters of circular high-contrast pixel groups on the lateral-most margins of both lobes. Isolated circular high-intensity spots at approximately mid-lobe horizontal coordinates.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple high-contrast linear pixel disruptions. Notable vertical linear mark on the right lobe medial area. Intersecting diagonal linear marks on the left lobe medial-distal area.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive linear rake marks across the ventral surface of both lobes; heavy calcium-intensity encrustation (barnacles) on the fluke tips.
other_distinctive_markers: Distinctive high-contrast white point-source markers located at coordinates [lower-left interior] and [lower-right interior] relative to the fluke center.
